name: Live Captions social share card by Live Captions by Subanana
description: A 1200×630 share card built like a sticker sheet: a warm amber canvas with large organic blob shapes, a left column carrying a die-cut logo badge, a three-line heavy headline outlined in white, and a yellow CTA pill. The right two-thirds is a hand-tilted collage of four pastel mini product surfaces — lavender, cream, pink and mint — each packed with one realistic detail such as a live caption with a blinking cursor, a captioned video frame, meeting notes and a transcript search. Thick white sticker borders, varied rotations and soft shadows unify the collage so the card still reads at chat-thumbnail size.
